So network is correct for those. So why A-X2 measurement 25? Our network gives two possible paths: A-M-X2 (5.555) and A-M-X1-N_b1-M-X2 (which includes a loop). But there is a loop: A-M-X1-N_b1-M-X2 includes M twice, which is not a simple path; effective resistance between A and X2 in a network with a loop may be higher due to parallel? Actually there is a loop: M connects to X1 and X2 and N_b1. The network forms a bridge. The equivalent resistance between A and X2 is not just series A-M + M-X2 because there is also a parallel path through X1 and N_b1. Need to compute correctly using circuit analysis.
